description: Continuous Monitoring Queries — Live System Watch

queries.name: Active User Sessions
queries.desc: Who is logged in right now
queries.sql: SELECT user, tty, host, pid, datetime(time,'unixepoch') AS login_time FROM logged_in_users WHERE type = 'user' ORDER BY time DESC;

queries.name: Running Process Count
queries.desc: Total number of processes currently running
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_processes FROM processes;

queries.name: Top Memory Consumers
queries.desc: Top 10 processes by memory usage
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, uid, ROUND(resident_size/1048576.0,2) AS memory_mb FROM processes ORDER BY resident_size DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.name: Recently Started Processes
queries.desc: Processes started in the last 10 minutes
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, uid, cmdline, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE start_time > (strftime('%s','now') - 600) ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: Established Connections
queries.desc: All active outbound network connections
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, s.local_address, s.local_port, s.remote_address, s.remote_port, s.state FROM process_open_sockets AS s JOIN processes AS p ON s.pid = p.pid WHERE s.state = 'ESTABLISHED' AND s.family = 2 AND s.remote_address != '127.0.0.1' ORDER BY s.remote_port;

queries.name: Listening TCP Ports
queries.desc: All TCP ports currently listening
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, l.port, l.address FROM listening_ports AS l JOIN processes AS p ON l.pid = p.pid WHERE l.protocol = 6 ORDER BY l.port;

queries.name: Connections to Rare Ports
queries.desc: Connections to non-standard ports — C2 indicator
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, p.path, s.remote_address, s.remote_port FROM process_open_sockets AS s JOIN processes AS p ON s.pid = p.pid WHERE s.state = 'ESTABLISHED' AND s.family = 2 AND s.remote_address != '127.0.0.1' AND s.remote_port NOT IN (80,443,22,53,25,587,993,995,8080,8443) ORDER BY s.remote_port;

queries.name: Processes in Temp Dirs
queries.desc: Processes running from /tmp or /dev/shm
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, uid, cmdline, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE path LIKE '/tmp/%' OR path LIKE '/dev/shm/%' OR path LIKE '/var/tmp/%' ORDER BY start_time DESC;

queries.name: Root Processes
queries.desc: All processes running as root
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE uid = 0 ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 20;

queries.name: Zombie Processes
queries.desc: Zombie processes — may indicate buggy or malicious parent
queries.sql: SELECT pid, name, parent, state, datetime(start_time,'unixepoch') AS started FROM processes WHERE state = 'Z';

queries.name: Files Modified in /etc (1h)
queries.desc: Config files changed in the last hour
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE path LIKE '/etc/%' AND mtime > (strftime('%s','now') - 3600) AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: New Files in /tmp (1h)
queries.desc: Files created in temp dirs in last hour
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, mode, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (directory = '/tmp' OR directory = '/dev/shm' OR directory = '/var/tmp') AND mtime > (strftime('%s','now') - 3600) AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: System Resource Snapshot
queries.desc: CPU cores, RAM, uptime summary
queries.sql: SELECT s.hostname, s.cpu_brand, s.cpu_logical_cores, ROUND(s.physical_memory/1073741824.0,2) AS memory_gb, u.days AS uptime_days, u.hours AS uptime_hours FROM system_info AS s, uptime AS u;

queries.name: Disk Usage
queries.desc: Filesystem usage across all mounts
queries.sql: SELECT path, device, type, ROUND(100.0-(blocks_free*100.0/blocks),1) AS percent_used FROM mounts WHERE blocks > 0 AND type NOT IN ('tmpfs','devtmpfs','proc','sysfs','cgroup','cgroup2') ORDER BY percent_used DESC;

queries.name: ARP Cache Changes
queries.desc: Current ARP table — spot new or suspicious entries
queries.sql: SELECT address, mac, interface FROM arp_cache ORDER BY interface, address;

queries.name: Cron Jobs Watch
queries.desc: Current state of all cron job files
queries.sql: SELECT path, filename, uid, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified FROM file WHERE (path LIKE '/etc/cron.d/%' OR path LIKE '/var/spool/cron/crontabs/%') AND type = 'regular' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: SSH Authorized Keys Watch
queries.desc: Monitor authorized_keys for new entries
queries.sql: SELECT path, uid, size, datetime(mtime,'unixepoch') AS modified, datetime(atime,'unixepoch') AS accessed FROM file WHERE path LIKE '/home/%/.ssh/authorized_keys' OR path = '/root/.ssh/authorized_keys' ORDER BY mtime DESC;

queries.name: Loaded Kernel Modules
queries.desc: All active kernel modules
queries.sql: SELECT name, size, status FROM kernel_modules WHERE status = 'Live' ORDER BY name;

queries.name: Process Groups By User
queries.desc: Count of running processes per user
queries.sql: SELECT u.username, COUNT(*) AS process_count FROM processes AS p JOIN users AS u ON p.uid = u.uid GROUP BY u.username ORDER BY process_count DESC;

queries.name: Open Files in Suspicious Paths
queries.desc: Processes with open files in /tmp or /dev/shm
queries.sql: SELECT p.name, p.pid, p.uid, f.path AS open_file FROM process_open_files AS f JOIN processes AS p ON f.pid = p.pid WHERE f.path LIKE '/tmp/%' OR f.path LIKE '/dev/shm/%' OR f.path LIKE '/var/tmp/%' ORDER BY p.name;
